chunks: It was narrated to me by Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Majiluwayh from his uncle Muhammad ibn Abi al-Qasim from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Umar ibn Khalid from Abi Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) used to fast in the month of Shaban and the month of Ramadan continuously, and he used to forbid people from connecting them. He used to say: 'These are the two months of Allah, and they are expiation for the sins between them, i.e., the sins of the previous and next months.'

key_terms.رَمَضَانَ: The ninth month of the Islamic lunar calendar, known for fasting
key_terms.شَعْبَانَ: The eighth month of the Islamic lunar calendar
key_terms.یَصِلُوهُمَا: To connect (the fasts of) the two months without breaking

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit of fasting in the month of Shaban according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq records the Prophet’s consistent practice of fasting in Shaban to bridge the gap between the sacred months, emphasizing that these fasts serve as comprehensive expiation for sins committed before and after this period. This tradition underscores the unique spiritual status of Shaban in Shia jurisprudence, where it is viewed not merely as a preparatory month but as a distinct time for divine forgiveness and spiritual cleansing.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 8. It was narrated to me by Muhammad b. Ali b. Majluwayh from his uncle Muhammad b. Abi al-Qasim from Ahmad b. Abi Abdillah from al-Hussain b. Sa’eed from Umar b. Khalid from Abi Ja’far (a.s.) who said:

“The Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) used to fast in the months of Shaban and Ramadan continuously. However he used to stop people from doing so.These are the months of Allah and they compensate for the sins of previous and next months.”
